purpose: Teach: カマ/ぽん/はいっ/よれ/たがら/辰/くろ/うぅ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、ご飯のカマを大切になさったぞ
lines.en: When you were young, Gran — your grandfather, he really treasured that rice cooker.
lines.style: Soft, measured pace. Opening drifts into memory like looking through old photographs. Tender precision on the specific detail. Voice settles lower on 'rice cooker' — the object anchoring the feeling.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お肩をぽんと叩いてくれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes — he'd give you a little pat on the shoulder, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright recognition, like she's been waiting to add her piece. Warm smile in the voice. Light bounce on 'pat' — the gesture comes alive in her telling. Gentle, inclusive question at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、突然お家にはいって来たぞ
lines.en: When you were young, Gran — he'd suddenly come through the door like that.
lines.style: Quieter now, more inward. Slight pause before 'suddenly' — the house feels different when he enters. Not wistful but witnessing. Voice holds steady, letting the scene breathe.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お洋服がよれてしまった日、悲しがられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He'd be so sad on the days when his clothes got worn and wrinkled, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Softer melody. Gentle sadness — not tragic but tender. Slight lingering on 'worn' like she's feeling his feeling. The question curls upward with care, almost protective.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ばあさんがお魚を食べたがらない日があったぞ
lines.en: When you were young, Gran — there were days she wouldn't want to eat fish.
lines.style: Quieter observation. Slight wonder — not judgment. Pause before naming it, like he's turning the detail over in his mind. Simple, accepting tone. The mystery stays gentle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、辰年生まれだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He was born in the Year of the Dragon, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Lighter tone, small brightness. Like she's offering a piece of the puzzle. Not connecting it outright but letting it sit there. Question is warm, inviting him to understand with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃんのくろい背広、立派だったぞ
lines.en: When you were young, Gran — his black suit was so fine.
lines.style: Admiration surfaces quietly. Slight lift on 'fine' — real pride in the quality, the care. Voice lingers on the image of him dressed well. Dignified but not distant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、うぅっと唸って疲れを見せられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He'd let out that little groan, you know — show his tiredness without hiding it, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial. Small chuckle under the surface — the sound of him groaning becomes audible in her voice. Intimate detail. Question lands with understanding, not asking but confirming they both know this exact sound.
